title: "Return the next segment of a support answer that exceeded the transport size bound."
description: "Requires a support scope of the operation that produced the answer, and the same principal. An answer above a transport bound (today the MCP limits.max_response_bytes) is returned as a segment instead of being discarded: concatenating `data` of every segment in order, following `segment.next_cursor` until it is null, yields the complete JSON answer byte for byte. Segments expire after ten minutes (`SEGMENT_UNKNOWN`; repeat the original call). Nothing is changed."

<MethodEndpoint

Requires a support scope of the operation that produced the answer, and the same principal. An answer above a transport bound (today the MCP limits.max_response_bytes) is returned as a segment instead of being discarded: concatenating `data` of every segment in order, following `segment.next_cursor` until it is null, yields the complete JSON answer byte for byte. Segments expire after ten minutes (`SEGMENT_UNKNOWN`; repeat the original call). Nothing is changed.
